newsitem.title: UK: Queen to start transatlantic replica voyage.
newsitem.headline: Queen to start transatlantic replica voyage.

text.p: Queen Elizabeth is to set sail for the New World, heading into the Atlantic in a tiny replica sailing ship.
But she will travel only the first mile of the voyage with her husband, Prince Philip, at the helm.

Their brief journey in May will mark the start of a seven-week voyage by a 1.5 million pound ($2.5 million) replica of the Matthew, flagship of the English explorer John Cabot who made his voyage of discovery to Newfoundland 500 years ago.
Project chairman John Hartnell told reporters on Tuesday: "This is fantastic news and icing on the cake for the project. I could not believe it when the queen accepted my invitation."
Queen Elizabeth will also be on hand to greet the ship when it is due in Canada on June 24.
